title: studio → pipelines: a gate's answer for one parked row
description: Studio's outbox relay publishes it on subject `cmd.pipeline.pick` (stream CMD) in the transaction that records the pick; Nats-Msg-Id `<batch_id>:<n>` (the batch's command counter). pipelines consumes it with the other cmd.pipeline.* (durable `pipelines`, in order) and resumes the row's thread parked on that gate visit with it (`take_ids`: pass, `reject`: the fail edge, the cap's `then`, or a plain edge's failure). A pick for a thread not parked on that gate visit and attempt is acked and dropped. A judge pick resumes the judge's gate part: take_ids → pass edge with that pick, reject → the judge's fail edge, its then, or (plain edge) the row fails `rejected at <judge>`; with `note`, pipelines writes one judge_example memory item (key = the judge id, source pick).

gate.description: the gate or (API 1.14) judge the row is parked on

take_ids.description: the picked takes, 1 to keep of the candidates

agreed.description: from API 1.14, a judge only (studio derives it): the picked set equals the judge's suggestion (reject all with an empty suggestion: true)

note.description: from API 1.14, a judge only: the user's note; pipelines stores the pick as a judge example (memory) with it
